overview.description: The BNY Mellon Emerging Markets Debt ETF (BEMD) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in broad credit fixed income. The fund primarily invests in fixed-income securities specifically issued from the undervalued sectors of the emerging markets. It may hold both government- and corporation-issued debt, select high yield bonds, and disregard maturities. BEMD was launched on Aug 14, 2026 and is issued by BNY Mellon.
